overview: This single-page file consists of a List of Papers index for State Department decimal file 894.92511, concerning time and the calendar in Japan. It records a January 12 communication from the Justice Department to the State Department about the Japanese calendar, accompanied by an excerpt from the 1936 edition of Whitaker's Almanack; the description of the excerpt is cut off in the surviving OCR.

subfiles.title: List of Papers for Japanese Calendar File 894.92511
subfiles.about: An index sheet records a January 12 Justice Department communication enclosing a 1936 Whitaker's Almanack excerpt about the Japanese calendar.
subfiles.summary: The sheet identifies the subject as “Time - Calendar - Japan” and the file number as 894.92511. Its sole entry records a communication from the Justice Department to the State Department dated January 12. The entry states that an excerpt from Whitaker's 1936 Almanack was enclosed to explain some aspect of the Japanese calendar, but the description ends incomplete.

interest: The page is useful chiefly as a provenance and contents record for material that is not reproduced in the supplied file text. It shows that U.S. officials consulted a standard British reference work when handling a question about the Japanese calendar, while its truncated description may help historians identify or reconstruct a missing enclosure or communication.
